Actions.use_case: Use to read the Azure Blob Storage Inventory policy on the customer storage account.
Use to create or update the Azure Blob Storage Inventory rule to configure inventory.
Use to delete the Azure Blob Storage Inventory rule.

Use to delete the inventory destination container.
